free_text: The patient is a 70-year-old male with a significantly elevated PSA of 17.0 ng/mL and a PI-RADS 5 MRI finding. Biopsy results are ISUP grade group 0, suggesting benign disease, despite the high PSA. The trade-off involves balancing the high PSA with negative biopsy findings against the high-risk imaging finding. Management is continued surveillance pending clinical review of treatment benefit and patient preferences.
